context.//: App-level context. Override the stage at deploy time with `cdk deploy -c stage=prod`. Region comes from AWS_REGION (see bin/app.ts) — Hyperframes Lambda rendering is single-region in v1.
context.//hyperframes: Defaults mirrored from .env.example so synth has sensible values without env. The api-server runtime reads the deployed equivalents at request time. NOTE: chromeSource is the short "sparticuz" token the @hyperframes/aws-lambda construct expects (verified against its 0.6.91 types) — NOT the npm package name "@sparticuz/chromium". concurrency maps to the construct's reservedConcurrency prop.
context.//cdk-feature-flags: Recommended modern CDK defaults. Trimmed to the ones that affect this stack; `cdk init` emits a longer list, but these are the load-bearing ones for S3 + IAM least privilege.
